_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ou ap jwe Klondike Solitaire. Objektif ou se deplase tout kat nan pil fondasyon yo.

Règ Jwèt la:
- Pil fondasyon yo (F1-F4): Bati soti nan As pou rive nan Wa nan menm koule
- Pil tablo yo (T1-T7): Bati desann nan koule altenatif (wouj sou nwa, nwa sou wouj)
- Stok: Tire kat nan pil fatra
- Fatra (W): Kat anwo a disponib pou jwe

Kòmand:
- 'draw' - Tire kat soti nan stok pou fatra
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Deplase kat ant pil yo
  Egzanp: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count kapab tou 'all', ki pral eseye deplase tout kat ki vire anwo.
- 'forfeit' - Fini jwèt la toutswit epi bloke skò ou aktyèl
- Non pil yo: W (fatra), F1-F4 (fondasyon), T1-T7 (tablo)

Ou kapab ekzekite plizyè aksyon nan yon tou sèlman pa separe yo ak virgul:
  Egzanp: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Sèlman Wa kapab mete sou pil tablo vid.
Aksyon yo ekzekite nan òd - si yon moun echwe, aksyon ki rete yo prale eskipe.
Itilize 'forfeit' si ou kwè jwèt la enposib pou genyen.

format_error.no_brackets: Fòma aksyon ki pa valab. Aksyon ta dwe nan parantès yo.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Format aksyon ki pa valab. manke fèmen bracket ']'

format_error.count_invalid: Kantite invalid. Itilize yon nimewo oswa 'all'
